name: A Firma Tattoo Company
bio:
Welcome to the artistry of A Firma Tattoo Company, nestled in the heart of scenic Garopaba, Brazil. Renowned for our meticulous dotwork tattoos, our collaborative team of ink virtuosos—including @bento.tattoo, @henriartetattoo, and @bohrertattoo—transform skin into canvas with precision and grace. Beyond tattoos, we're your holistic destination for self-expression, offering expert piercing from @gabiruivapiercer and bespoke eyebrow design by @emillyjuliasobrancelhass.
Price: $
Current location: Garopaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil
